title: BNI3: three-stage Boolean network inference from sparse transcriptomic time series
description: BNI3 infers Boolean gene regulatory networks from sparse transcriptomic time series in three stages: binarization of expression, rule inference and evaluation, and attractor analysis with in-silico perturbations.
